## 🔱 Dharma Daily Pull Request

### Description
Please describe the motivation behind these changes and what features/fixes are included.

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Astronomical Panchang calculation refinement
- [ ] Scripture / Text corrections
- [ ] Documentation update

### Testing & Verification
- [ ] `flutter test` passes 100%
- [ ] Verified UI on device/emulator
- [ ] Verified data integrity for offline JSON assets

### Checklist
- [ ] Code complies with project formatting guidelines (`dart format`)
- [ ] No static analysis warnings (`flutter analyze`)
- [ ] Added unit/widget test for new functionality if applicable
